title: 2013 Keynote: Chandler Carruth: Optimizing the Emergent Structures of C++
summary: Chandler Carruth's CppNow 2013 keynote on how C++ builds complex software from simple emergent structures, and how compilers optimize them through inlining and value semantics.
why: HN lists it among C++ optimization talks and cites it for how much optimizer performance comes from inlining, from an experienced compiler engineer.
